verdict.rationale: Firebase Cloud Storage is only indirectly evidenced: security rules docs confirm access-rule enforcement for Cloud Storage (firebase-docs-10, 18) and it's listed in the Emulator Suite (firebase-docs-24), but there is no dedicated documentation about file upload APIs or CDN-backed delivery of served files. Missing for 10: direct Cloud Storage upload/serve documentation, CDN/edge delivery evidence, independent corroboration of performance/reliability.
